items.stem: You carry a balance on a credit card at 22% APR and have spare cash. What usually gives the best guaranteed return?

options.text: Paying down the high-interest card balance
options.rationale: Correct: eliminating 22% interest is a guaranteed return few investments beat.
Lotteries have a negative expected return and are not a strategy.

options.text: Leaving the cash in a checking account
options.rationale: A checking account earns little while the 22% interest keeps accruing.

options.text: Making only the minimum card payment
options.rationale: Minimum payments let the high interest keep compounding against you.

items.explanation: Correct: eliminating 22% interest is a guaranteed return few investments beat.

items.stem: Which statements about an emergency fund are sound? (Select TWO)

options.text: It should be kept somewhere safe and quickly accessible
options.rationale: Correct: an emergency fund must be available on short notice.

options.text: A common target is several months of essential expenses
options.rationale: Correct: a few months of essential spending is a widely used guideline.

options.text: It should be fully invested in volatile stocks for growth
options.rationale: Volatile assets can fall just when you need the cash, defeating its purpose.

options.text: It is unnecessary if you have a credit card
options.rationale: A credit card is debt, not savings, and may be unavailable in a crisis.

items.explanation: Correct: an emergency fund must be available on short notice.

items.stem: Why does starting to invest for retirement earlier generally help, even with small amounts?

options.text: Compound growth has more time to work on contributions
options.rationale: Correct: more time lets returns compound on earlier returns.

options.text: Markets always rise every single year
options.rationale: Markets fluctuate; the benefit comes from time and compounding, not a guarantee.
Fees apply regardless of when you start; starting early does not remove them.
You can contribute later too; starting early simply adds more compounding time.

items.explanation: Correct: more time lets returns compound on earlier returns.
